race.comment: POSTER PERFECT (3) was good in a higher-graded race at her latest appearance at Shepparton, coming from this barrier to be beaten just 1.6 metres into fourth. Freshened since but kept up to the mark with a nice trial and is suited returning to a venue where she has recorded a win and a placing in two previous visits. TOTALLY STUNNING (10) has been good from wide barriers in both starts off a spell, winning fresh at Shepparton before a second here last time. Draws on the back row but is going well. LA SMOOCH (5) placed when fresh and is proven second-up so could progress. SECRET LINE (2) is aided by a low draw and brings good form with a win and two placings from his last three attempts at this circuit and distance.
